decisions.reason: Although the UV spot varnishing system is more distant from the firm's core know-how, it remains strategically important for digital print enhancement and is likely kept while the firm continues building application and service knowledge around it.

The sheet preparation module draws directly on the firm's existing finishing and workflow capabilities, giving high absorptive capacity and making continued commercialization and improvement relatively easy.
The B2-format multifinisher is both close to the established portfolio and a stated strategic focus, so management is very likely to continue backing it in an expanding market.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's booklet-making and binding competence well, though as a less highlighted product it still carries some moderate risk of later portfolio rationalization.
The folding add-on unit strongly complements the installed base and already has a concrete user case, so the firm has little reason to withdraw it within the next year.
